intervals.note: BESIII observed the first BEPCII collisions in July 2008; the BEPCII National Acceptance Test was passed in July 2009.
intervals.quote: In July 2008, the first collisions took place at BEPCII, the upgraded BEPC, and were observed by the new BESIII detector.

intervals.label: BEPCII data taking
intervals.locator: IHEP history page (timeline); end from the IPAC'26 paper (BEPCII shut down on 1 July 2024)
intervals.note: Start is the BEPCII acceptance-test month. The end is the BEPCII shutdown date for the upgrade, not a BESIII-specific statement.
intervals.quote: In July 2009, the Upgrade Project, BEPCII, successfully passed the National Acceptance Test organized by the National Development and Reform Commission

intervals.label: BEPCII upgrade shutdown
intervals.locator: Geng et al., IPAC'26 WEP1606, abstract
intervals.note: The collider has been shut down for its upgrade since 1 July 2024 and was in commissioning in 2026 (design luminosity reported achieved 28 April 2026); no fetched source states whether BESIII physics data taking has resumed, so the experiment is recorded as in shutdown. The collaboration remains active (new results and a September 2026 workshop on its website).
intervals.quote: The upgrade of Beijing Electron and Positron Collider-II (BEPCII) has begun since the shutdown of BEPCII on July 1st in 2024.
